no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: VolitionRx is an in vitro diagnostics company (Nu.Q nucleosomics platform). It develops blood-based diagnostic tests (Nu.Q NETs, Nu.Q Cancer, Nu.Q Vet Cancer Test, Capture-Seq) and research products, not therapeutic drug candidates. No active interventional drug trials in Phase 1/2/3 are sponsored by the company.

website.note: Diagnostics pipeline only (Nu.Q NETs, Nu.Q Cancer, Nu.Q Vet, Capture-Seq, Nu.Q Discover). No drug pipeline page.

ctgov.note: No company-sponsored interventional drug trials in Phase 1/2/3.
